name: Glossy Glass
author: ASQUALL-hub
description: DiscTray's Glossy Glass look for the Steam client: see-through glass windows with a wet gloss, bright double rims and tinted candy buttons. The Steam Glass helper (installed with SteamGlassUpdater.exe from github.com/ASQUALL-hub/steam-glossy-glass) does the see-through part.

Glass.description: Frosted blurs what is behind Steam, with Windows' rounded corners. Clear is fully see-through with DiscTray's squircle corners. Liquid is DiscTray's Liquid: water that sloshes when you drag the window. Pick the same in the Steam Glass tray icon.
